outputs.notes: Added features/plan/utils/schoolDays.ts exporting `isOffDay(dayIndex, schoolDays?: DayOfWeek[])` and `DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAYS` (Mon–Fri) as named exports — this is the shared source the next LessonTaskForm-touching phase (item 3) should reuse/import, not redefine. WeekGrid.tsx and WeeklyList.tsx now derive off-day styling from `useHousehold().householdProfile.schoolDays` via isOffDay() instead of a hardcoded isWeekend(dayIndex===0||6); both components had to start calling useHousehold(), so their integration test files (WeekGrid.test.tsx, WeeklyList.test.tsx) now mock '@/features/household/front/context' (standard project pattern, matches WeeklyPlannerPage.test.tsx). LessonTaskForm.tsx gained an optional `schoolDays?: DayOfWeek[]` PROP (not an internal useHousehold() call, to avoid breaking ~30 existing tests that render it without a HouseholdProvider) — its three real callers (LessonsPage.tsx, WeeklyPlannerPage.tsx, EditLessonModal.tsx) already call useHousehold() and now pass householdProfile?.schoolDays through. The warning is a dismissible amber inline box (role=status) shown when dueDate or plannedStartDate falls on an off day; it resets its dismissed state when either date changes; submission is never blocked. WeekGrid's drag-and-drop InlineSuccess message now appends '(an off day)' when the drop target is an off day (undoNotice gained an `isOffDayTarget: boolean` field). SchedulePage.tsx shows a small amber 'Off day' pill next to the page heading, only in day view, when selectedDate's weekday is an off day per household.schoolDays. Did not touch db/schema.ts, LessonGenerationPanel.tsx, or resources/server/service.ts (out of scope per plan). GradebookPage.tsx references LessonTaskForm only in a code comment, not an actual usage — no wiring needed there.

outputs.notes: Chose the 'always-visible with clearer copy' variant from decided-design option 1 (not toggle+reveal) — kept the existing two <input type="date"> fields and their 'Available from'/'Due date' labels completely unchanged (required: an existing regression test explicitly asserts 'Available from' is present AND 'Start date' is absent, so relabeling the field itself was out). Only the helper paragraph below the date grid changed, from mechanism-first ('Lesson can be completed any day from Available-from through Due-date') to outcome-first ('Setting both dates makes this lesson span multiple days — it will appear every day from Available-from through Due-date, for example Monday through Friday for a lesson that runs all week'). Updated the one pre-existing test that asserted the old copy verbatim, plus added two new tests: one asserting the outcome-first copy is present (discoverability), one exercising a new 'This week (Mon–Fri)' quick-pick button that sets plannedStartDate to that Monday and dueDate to that Friday of the current due-date's week (pure client-side date math, no new field, no API change). The off-day warning box from item 2 (role=status, dismissible, keyed off dueDate/plannedStartDate changes) sits immediately below this block and was left completely untouched — verified by re-running the full 'off-day (household schoolDays) awareness' describe block, all still green. TodayLessonCard.tsx: swapped both filter sites (the internal-fetch path at the old line 62 and the externalLessons path at the old line 81) from `l.dueDate === today` to `lessonSpansDate(l, today)`, imported from features/plan/utils/lessonCompletionWindow.ts (pre-existing, tested utility — no new file). Pure predicate swap, no other behavior change: loading/error/empty states, optimistic Mark-done/Skip, child-name chips, and the mondayOfWeek week-fetch range are all untouched. Regression-tested that a single-day lesson (no plannedStartDate) still only appears on its own due date, since lessonSpansDate degrades to dueDate===dateStr in that case. WeekGrid.test.tsx ('renders window lesson on intermediate days, not only due date') and WeeklyList.test.tsx ('shows window lesson on days inside the completion window', asserting the card appears on both Monday and Wednesday of a Mon–Wed window) were verified (not assumed) to already adequately cover the '3-day span renders in matrix/list' acceptance criterion — per the plan's own instruction to verify existing fixtures before adding new ones, no new WeekGrid/WeeklyList tests were added. Did not touch db/schema.ts, LessonTask type, or any server/repository file — this was a pure UI-layer (LessonTaskForm.tsx, TodayLessonCard.tsx) change as scoped.
